text: At the Pallister Cup on Saturday, the yacht Seren Aduial was captained by Lucas Wetherby, according to the race committee and the crew members I spoke with on the marina dock after the final leg. Wetherby, of East Quay, steered the 34-foot sloop through a steady southerly and brought her in second overall, just 18 seconds behind the winner. Crewman Tessa Millin said Wetherby “kept his nerve when the wind shifted off Brine Point.” Committee records handed to me list Wetherby as skipper for the 14 June race, and I saw his name painted on the cockpit board when the boat was hauled in later that afternoon.
